  AGENDA
  OF A REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to
on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If
applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the
agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk’s office during normal business
hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make
inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be
made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the
Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours
prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.

The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however,
to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a
presentation shall be limited to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council shall
fill out a green speaker’s card available at the end of each row in the Chambers. The card permits
the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific
agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City
Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of
items shown on the agenda.

    Presentation from Offices of State Senator Wright and Assemblymember Lowenthal on the

    Swearing-In of Police Chief John Eberhard (Chief Dreiling)

MAYOR'S REPORT - MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST

CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 - 1 - 7a-e)

All items under this heading are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion,
unless a Councilmember, staff, or member of the public requests that an item be removed for
separate discussion. An applicant or interested citizen who wishes to appeal any Planning
Commission decision (Item #7a-e) may file an appeal with the City Clerk’s office within 15
days after the date of the Planning Commission’s decision.

Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered immediately following the
motion to approve the Consent Agenda.

1.  Waive Further Reading

  Recommendation: After the City Attorney has read the title, waive full reading of
  ordinances considered on this agenda for introduction on first reading or adoption
  on second reading.

2.  City Council Minutes of September 11, 2012

  Recommendation: Review and Approve.

3.  City Treasurer's Reports

  Recommendation: Receive and File.

  a.  July 2012
  b.  August 2012

4.  Special Event Application by the Lunada Bay Homeowners Association to Host the
  Annual Harvest Festival and Post Signs Promoting the Event

  Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the request by
  the Lunada Bay Homeowners Association to host the annual Harvest Festival on

   Sunday, October 28, 2012 from 11:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. at Lunada Bay Park and the
  streets adjacent to the Park on Via Anacapa and Yarmouth Road, and approve
  promotional signs at both permitted locations for the allowable time.

5.  Parklands Committee Meeting Items of September 10, 2012

  Recommendation: Review and Approve.

  a.  PC-346-12; Application to remove 1 Eucalyptus tree and 1 Australian tea tree
  located in the parkway adjacent to 101 Via Colusa

  Applicant:  Mark Paullin
  16100 South Figueroa
  Gardena, CA 90248

  Action: Approved (5-0). The applicant is approved to remove 1 Eucalyptus tree and
  1 Australian tea tree in the parkway adjacent to 101 Via Colusa according to the
  ‘Standard Conditions For Tree Removal Approvals’. A $500 payment to the ‘Tree
  Bank’ is required for each tree removed.

  b.  PC-347-12; Application to top all trees and shrubs located in the parklands adjacent
  to 549 Via Del Monte

  Applicant:  Robert and Linda Moffat
  541 Via Del Monte
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

  Action: Approved (5-0). The applicant is approved to top all trees and shrubs
  located in parklands (between the property line and the power lines) adjacent to 549
  Via Del Monte with a no-fee permit on an as needed basis.

  c.  PC-348-12; Application to remove 5 pine trees located in the parkway adjacent to
  1364 Via Coronel, 1 Eucalyptus tree and 1 Redwood tree located in the parkway
  adjacent to 1368 Via Coronel and 1 Olive tree located in the parkway adjacent to
  1369 Via Coronel

  Applicant:  Diana Cahill
  1369 Via Coronel
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

  Action: Approved (5-0). The applicant is approved to remove 8 trees located in the
  parkways adjacent to 1364, 1368 and 1369 Via Coronel according to the ‘Standard
  Conditions For Tree Removal Approvals’. A $4,000 payment to the ‘Tree Bank’ is
  required.

September 25, 2012
  3
 6.  Traffic Safety Committee Meeting Item of September 12, 2012

  Recommendation: Review and Approve.

  a.  Traffic Calming Application for 953 Granvia Altamira

  Action: Recommended that staff install temporary edgeline striping on the north
  side of Granvia Altamira and bring the item back for review in six months and 2)
  Recommended that staff and the Traffic Engineer create a striping plan for adjusting
  the street centerline and bring the item back for future review. (Approved 5-0)

7.  Planning Commission Actions of September 18, 2012

  Recommendation: Receive and File.

  a.  CUP-35R-12; Consideration of a revised Conditional Use Permit application for
  modifications to the existing wireless telecommunication facility located at the
  multi-family residential building located at 2525 Via Campesina. Lot 1, Tract
  31753.

  Applicant:  Sprint PCS
  2749 Saturn St.
  Brea, CA 92821
  Owner:  Villa Florenze Condominium Homeowners’ Assoc.

  Action: Approved (5-0) with standard conditions and the following additional
  conditions: 1) No additional noise impacts may be generated by the new equipment;
  2) The Revised Conditional Use Permit is subject to annual review.

  b.  CDP-80R/GA-1473R-12; Consideration of revised Coastal Development Permit
  and revised Grading applications for a new pool and spa at the single family
  residence located at 3004 Paseo Del Mar.  Parcel 2 of parcel map 70848, as
  recorded in PMB 367-12-14.

  Applicant:  Jesus Meza
  5912 Tipton Way
  Los Angeles, CA 90042
  Owner:  Chris Delgado & Cynthia Williams

  Action: Approved (5-0) with standard conditions.

  c.  NC-1079RII-12; Consideration of a revised Neighborhood Compatibility
  application for additions to the single family residence located at 936 Via Rincon.
  Lot 12, Block 1630, Tract 7142.

CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
September 25, 2012
  4
   Applicant:  DW Engineering
  3035 Kashiwa St., #104
  Torrance, CA 90505
  Owner:  Hsin Yu Lin

  Action: Approved (5-0) with standard conditions.

  d.  V-86-12; Consideration of a Variance application for mechanical equipment
  proposed in the front yard at the single family residence located at 1416 Paseo La
  Cresta. Lot 5, Block 2, Tract 8043.

  Applicant:  LT Generators
  18314 Oxnard St., #6
  Tarzana, CA 91356
  Owner:  Mr. & Mrs. Rogers

  Action: Approved (5-0) with standard conditions and the following additional
  condition: 1) The equipment is to be surrounded by a sound-attenuating structure.

  e.  NC-1450-12; Consideration of a Neighborhood Compatibility application for a new
  single family residence located at 4021 Via Solano. Lot 18, Block 6201, Tract
  6887.

  Applicant:  Jeffrey A. Dahl
  18681 Amalia Lane
  Huntington Beach, CA 92648
  Owner:  Rick & Eve Higgins
  3949 Palos Verdes Dr. North
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

  Action: Approved (5-0) with standard conditions and the following additional
  conditions: 1) The attic space is to be less than 7 ft. in height; 2) A licensed survey
  of the building coverage is to be completed and submitted by a licensed surveyor to
  verify compliance with the approved coverage for the subject lot; 3) All
  nonstandard encroachments shall be removed; 4) The driveway is to be built per the
  Public Works Department standards; 5) The ridge height of the family room loggia
  area is to be reduced by one foot from what is shown on the plans; 6) The applicant
  is to maintain a privacy hedge between the property and the property at 4017 Via
  Solano in the area indicated on the site plan at the project’s eave height.

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT
on the agenda. Due to state law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters
presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be

 referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.

PUBLIC HEARINGS

All persons addressing the City Council during public hearings shall be limited to three (3)
minutes for comment, except for an Appellant/Applicant, which shall be provided five (5)
minutes for presentation and rebuttal.

OLD BUSINESS

8.  Adoption of Resolution R12-22, Approving Monthly Boarding Rates and Other Fees and
  Charges for the Palos Verdes Stable Effective October 1, 2012 and Approval of
  Contribution from the City's Stable Fund for the Arena Lighting Project

  Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution R12-
  22, approving monthly boarding rates and other fees and charges for the Palos
  Verdes Stable effective October 1, 2012, and approve a contribution not to exceed
  $17,000 from the City's Stable fund to assist in financing the arena lighting project.

NEW BUSINESS

9.  “Pace Car” Program – Citizen Pledge to Observe Traffic Laws / Drive the Speed Limit
  (Traffic Safety Committee Meeting Item of September 12, 2012)

  Traffic Safety Committee Recommended Action: The Traffic Safety Committee
  voted unanimously to recommend that staff develop a Pace Car program including
  metrics to measure the results and promotion of the program.

STAFF REPORTS

10.  City Manager's Report

DEMANDS

11.  Demands of September 25, 2012

  Recommendation: Authorize Payment of Motions #1 and #2.

  a.  Authorize Payment of Motion #1 - Payroll Warrant of September 14, 2012
  b.  Authorize Payment of Motion #2 - Warrant Register of September 25, 2012
